This list represents the dialect of Nyuwar (Hill Longuda); the informant was Dedan Amaku [àmáákù]. Dr. Jungraithmayr has further information on related languages, such as Waja, Tula, Dadiya, Burak, Awak; some forms from these were included in the questionnaire, but not enough from any one language to justify its inclusion.

Mr. Kachalla's home town is Bobini of Guyuk district, Numan division, and the dialect is clearly somewhat different from that of Nyuwar.
Transcription: English-type orthography converted in general as follows: ch > tʃ, j > dʒ, sh > ʃ, zh > ʒ (more doubtfully), y > j. (This will be summarized in future as 'Orthographic conversion'.) N.B.: A note by Dr. Ballard shows that in this list is not [θ]; it is therefore left. [[SRC #698 in VOL2]]
